limitations: Two rows in R^2, positive nonorthogonal inner product, finite independent fresh noise, unrelaxed exact projections. At alternating endpoint the row process is periodic. No multivariate generalization or independent validation asserted.
scientific_integrity: Analytic two-row theorem; independent innovations and stationary Markov row selection are essential; finite checker is corroboration rather than exhaustive proof.
title: Sharp rate–noise Pareto frontier for two-row Markov Kaczmarz
